name: hoodlefinance
description: Local development tooling for the HOODLEFINANCE Apps Script project.

scripts.test: npm run build:ts && node --test test/*.test.js test-ts/*.test.js test-ts/core-flow/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.check:ts:test: npm run build:ts && node --test test-ts/*.test.js test-ts/core-flow/*.test.js
scripts.check:ts: npm run typecheck && npm run check:ts:test
scripts.check:ts:coverage: npm run build:ts && c8 --all --src dist/ts --exclude 'tools/**' --exclude 'test-ts/**' --report-dir /tmp/hoodlefinance-ts-coverage --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov node --test test-ts/*.test.js test-ts/core-flow/*.test.js
scripts.check:ts:all: npm run check:ts && npm run check:ts:coverage && npm run check:ts:dead
scripts.check:syntax: node --check hoodlefinance.js && node --check test/hoodlefinance.test.js && node --check tools/release/release.js && node --check test/release.test.js && node --check tools/cli-reporting.js && node --check tools/clasp-user-slots.js && node --check tools/clasp-user-login.js && node --check test/clasp-user-login.test.js && node --check tools/demo/sync.js && node --check tools/demo/validate-credentials.js && node --check test/sync-demo-sheet.test.js && node --check test/validate-demo-credentials.test.js && node --check tools/addon/deploy.js && node --check tools/show-clasp-user.js && node --check test/deploy-addon.test.js && node --check tools/license/spdx-headers.js && node --check test/spdx-headers.test.js && node --check tools/generate-preferred-reit-whitelist.js && node --check test/generate-preferred-reit-whitelist.test.js && node --check tools/act/create-secrets.js
scripts.build:ts: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/ts', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:all: npm run build:ts && npm run build:legacy:appscript:min && node tools/build-appscript-ts.js && node tools/build-appscript-ts.js --minify
